title: Consolidate delegable-operation wiring into one declarative registry
summary: Charter delegation for external operations previously required four coordinated per-op edits (delegable flag, grant schema/parser, target builder, resolver whitelist). The EXTERNAL_OPERATION_DELEGATION table in external-operation-target.ts now carries fields + buildTarget + reputational_class per op; all four consumers read it, so a same-shaped op is one line and other action domains register their own extractors with the same exact-grant envelope shape.

expected_outcome: When introducing declarative registration for per-op policy, keep the boundary flag (delegable), the strict grant parser, the effect-to-target builder and the attach whitelist reading one spec object. Runtime registration hooks are order-fragile; a static exported table is safer for governance code.
